description: Manifest mapping claims 'J7 MOTHER queue → Group B'. Sprint-1 REQ-J7 routes EXHAUSTED slots to a separate MOTHER instance that 'reads and remediates'. Sprint-2 Group B (REQ-B1..B4) provides bot2bot.sh that 'creates a gh issue' and 'polls open bot2bot-* issues' but defines no contract for what happens when ALL local recovery is exhausted AND no sibling instance is online AND no PR is forthcoming. Sprint-1 had `mother-recovery-queue.jsonl` as the EXHAUSTED sink with the property: 'when no slot can act, the queue persists work to disk so the MOTHER eventually picks it up'. Sprint-2 has no such durable exhausted-sink — REQ-B2 poll only fetches gh-side issues, REQ-B1 only posts new ones. If no sibling answers, the request is lost. Replace with: an explicit EXHAUSTED jsonl + a 'next pass re-posts after backoff' contract.

evidence.snippet: REQ-B1..B4 — no durable exhausted-sink contract; relies on gh issue staying open + sibling instance eventually polling.
